promptContext: You are translating the README for champollion, an open-source developer tool (npm package) that translates locale files and content. This is a technical README shown on GitHub and npm — professional, developer-facing tone, no marketing fluff. Preserve ALL markdown formatting, links, badges, code blocks, CLI commands, config keys, package names, and URLs exactly as-is. Only translate prose, section headings, and table description cells. Keep proper nouns in English (Champollion, Docusaurus, OpenRouter, DeepL). The project was born from translating a production website into Plains Cree (an Indigenous language) — treat references to Indigenous languages with cultural respect.

zh.register: Professional Simplified Chinese (简体中文). Modern technical documentation register. Use established Chinese technical terms (批处理, 缓存, 插件) but keep proper nouns in English. Developer-facing — assume the reader writes code.
